policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Harding lose an eighth match, still without a win Harding have played eight matches and lost all eight, with no win and no draw to set against them. Fort Hays State were the latest side to beat them, and no programme in the division has lost as often.
